# Nova UI

> Nova UI is a design system of 72 web components (Stencil) with wrappers for React, Next.js, Angular and Vue, a responsive CSS library, a Tailwind preset and an optional rich text editor. Components are framework-neutral, themed with CSS variables, accessible by default, and follow WCAG 2.2 AA.

## Start here

- [Getting started](docs/users/getting-started.md): install and first component in five minutes
- [Concepts](docs/users/concepts.md): how props, events, slots and forms work
- [Troubleshooting](docs/users/troubleshooting.md): common problems and fixes
